tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and lists.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken fills: inputs, segmented-control track, chips at rest.

tokens.name: surface-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs (dark: one step lighter than surface instead of a shadow).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards in dark mode. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that carry meaning (outlined button, input, toggle track off): 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts, on bg, surface, surface-2 and surface-sheet.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, captions, labels — on bg, surface, surface-2 and surface-sheet.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions (FAB, main button, active tab, selected chip, toggle on); as text on bg, surface and brand-soft.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a brand fill — never hard-code white.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: active-tab pill, selected chip, the ‘your share’ panel.

tokens.name: on-brand-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid / savings as text or icon, on surface, bg and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text (paid chip, savings card).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Awaiting-confirmation mark: badge dot, icon, 3:1 border. Not for small text on light — use warning-ink.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Awaiting confirmation / trial-ending text and icons, on warning-soft, surface and bg.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the Awaiting-confirmation card and badge. Calm amber, never red.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete — text, icon and the destructive button fill; text on surface, bg, danger-soft.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text (delete confirmation).

tokens.name: tile-ring
tokens.usage: 1px inner ring on service tiles so near-background tile colours keep an edge.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Category slot 1 — AI. Chart marks only; labels stay in ink (light < 3:1 needs the visible legend).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Category slot 2 — Storage. Chart marks only.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Category slot 3 — Telecom. Chart marks only; light < 3:1, legend always shown.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Category slot 4 — Software. Chart marks only; light < 3:1, legend always shown.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Category slot 5 — Video. Chart marks only; light < 3:1, legend always shown.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Category slot 6 — Music. Chart marks only.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: Every further category folds into Other (Games, Reading, Health, Learning, Other).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a bottom sheet or dialog.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / switch-access focus ring colour — an alias of brand (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: on-tile-light
tokens.usage: Monogram letter on a service tile; pick whichever of on-tile-light / on-tile-dark gives ≥ 4.5:1 with the tile colour.

tokens.name: on-tile-dark
tokens.usage: Monogram letter on a service tile; pick whichever of on-tile-light / on-tile-dark gives ≥ 4.5:1 with the tile colour.

tokens.name: tile-crimson
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-light (5.2:1).

tokens.name: tile-orange
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-dark (5.3:1).

tokens.name: tile-amber
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-dark (10.4:1).

tokens.name: tile-lime
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-dark (8.8:1).

tokens.name: tile-green
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-dark (5.4:1).

tokens.name: tile-teal
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-dark (4.6:1).

tokens.name: tile-sky
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-dark (6.3:1).

tokens.name: tile-blue
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-light (6.2:1).

tokens.name: tile-violet
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-light (5.8:1).

tokens.name: tile-pink
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-dark (4.8:1).

tokens.name: tile-brown
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-light (5.8:1).

tokens.name: tile-graphite
tokens.usage: Custom-service tile colour (same in every theme). Letter: on-tile-light (12.7:1).

families.sans: "Be Vietnam Pro", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Be Vietnam Pro (Google Fonts, full Vietnamese diacritics). Money always uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The total-spend hero on Overview, and Calendar's month total. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Editable amounts: the price in the form, the amount in the confirm sheet.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet titles, top-bar titles, section headings.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Row and card titles; row amounts (tabular).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Dùng thử Spotify hết sau 2 ngày — huỷ nếu không muốn bị tính phí.
styles.usage: Default text, card copy, field values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented control, tab-free labels.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Row meta line, helper text, ‘in 3 days’.

spacing.note: 4/8 grid. Screen gutter is space-4 (16px) so 360-wide Android fits.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tile-to-text gap in rows; between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, card padding, row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero top/bottom breathing room.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state illustration margins.

radius.note: Soft and friendly; tiles scale their radius with size (≈ 0.27 × side).

tokens.name: radius-tile-24
tokens.usage: 24px tile (calendar, stacked avatars).

tokens.name: radius-tile-40
tokens.usage: 40px tile (list rows).

tokens.name: radius-tile-56
tokens.usage: 56px tile (form header, sheet).

tokens.name: radius-tile-80
tokens.usage: 80px tile (detail hero).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segmented-control thumb, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, FAB, toggle, pill indicators.

shadow.note: Light theme: very soft shadows. Dark theme: no card shadow — elevation comes from a lighter surface and the line hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups at rest (dark: a 1px line ring).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: FAB, bottom sheet, toasts.

size.note: Touch targets and fixed component heights.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on every control.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Subscription row height (40px tile + 2 lines).

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Primary / secondary buttons.

tokens.name: fab-size
tokens.usage: Floating add button.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Tab bar, excluding the home-indicator inset.
